5;\n264\t        let sec_body = &msg[body_start..body_start + body_len];\n265\t\n266\t        match sec_num {\n267\t            1 => {\n268\t                let (center, subcenter, ref_time) = parse_section1(sec_body)?;\n269\t                builder.center = Some(center);\n270\t                builder.subcenter = Some(subcenter);\n271\t                builder.ref_time = Some(ref_time);\n272\t            }\n273\t            2 => { /* Local Use section — skip */ }\n274\t            3 => {\n275\t                let (gdt, grid) = parse_section3(sec_body)?;\n276\t                builder.gdt_template = Some(gdt);\n277\t                builder.grid = Some(grid);\n278\t            }\n279\t            4 => {\n280\t                let (pdt, param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_section4(sec_body, discipline)?;\n281\t                builder.pdt_template = Some(pdt);\n282\t                builder.parameter = Some(param);\n283\t                builder.forecast = Some(fore);\n284\t                builder.level = Some(lvl);\n285\t                builder.ensemble = Some(ens);\n286\t            }\n287\t            5 => {\n288\t                let (drt, packing, complex_extra, n_packed) = parse_section5(sec_body)?;\n289\t                builder.drt_template = Some(drt);\n290\t                builder.packing = Some(packing);\n291\t                builder.complex_extra = complex_extra;\n292\t                builder.n_packed = Some(n_packed);\n293\t            }\n294\t            6 => {\n295\t                let (has_bitmap, bitmap) = parse_section6(sec_body)?;\n296\t                builder.has_bitmap = Some(has_bitmap);\n297\t                builder.bitmap = bitmap;\n298\t            }\n299\t            7 => {\n300\t                let n_grid = builder.grid.as_ref().map(|g| g.num_data_points as usize).unwrap_or(0);\n301\t                let has_bitmap = builder.has_bitmap.unwrap_or(false);\n302\t                // When a bitmap is present, Section 5 n_packed < n_grid. Use n_packed\n303\t                // for the data unpackers (which only see the \"present\" subset).\n304\t                let n_decode = if has_bitmap {\n305\t                    builder.n_packed.unwrap_or(n_grid)\n306\t                } else {\n307\t                    n_grid\n308\t                };\n309\t                let packing = builder.packing.as_ref().ok_or(Error::NotImplemented)?;\n310\t                let drt = builder.drt_template.unwrap_or(0);\n311\t                let packed_values = decode_section7(\n312\t                    sec_body, packing, drt, builder.complex_extra.as_ref(), n_decode,\n313\t                )?;\n314\t                // Expand packed values into the full grid using the bitmap (if present).\n315\t                let values = if has_bitmap {\n316\t                    expand_bitmap(packed_values, &builder.bitmap, n_grid)\n317\t                } else {\n318\t                    packed_values\n319\t                };\n320\t                builder.values = Some(values);\n321\t\n322\t                // Complete field — flush the builder.\n323\t                let prev_grid = builder.grid.clone();\n324\t                let prev_gdt_template = builder.gdt_template;\n325\t                let next_builder = FieldBuilder {\n326\t                    center: builder.center,\n327\t                    subcenter: builder.subcenter,\n328\t                    ref_time: builder.ref_time,\n329\t                    // Preserve grid definition for subsequent fields in multi-field messages\n330\t                    grid: prev_grid,\n331\t                    gdt_template: prev_gdt_template,\n332\t                    ..Default::default()\n333\t                };\n334\t                if let Some(field) = builder.build() {\n335\t                    out.push(field);\n336\t                }\n337\t                builder = next_builder;\n338\t            }\n339\t            _ => { /* Unknown section — skip */ }\n340\t        }\n341\t\n342\t        // Advance buf.pos to the end of this section.\n343\t        buf.pos = sec_start + sec_len;\n344\t    }\n345\t\n346\t    // Consume \"7777\" end marker.\n347\t    let end = &msg[body_end..body_end + 4];\n348\t    if end != b\"7777\" {\n349\t        return Err(Error::TooShort { needed: 4, got: 0 });\n350\t    }\n351\t\n352\t    Ok(total_len)\n353\t}\n354\t\n355\t// ── Section 1: Identification ─────────────────────────────────────────────────\n356\t\n357\tfn parse_section1(body: &[u8]) -> Result<(u16, u16, ReferenceTime)> {\n358\t    let mut b = Buf::new(body);\n359\t    // oct 6-7 of section (indices 0-1 in body): originating center\n360\t    let center = b.read_u16be()?;\n361\t    // oct 8-9: originating subcenter\n362\t    let subcenter = b.read_u16be()?;\n363\t    b.skip(1)?; // master tables version\n364\t    b.skip(1)?; // local tables version\n365\t    let significance = b.read_u8()?;\n366\t    let year = b.read_u16be()?;\n367\t    let month = b.read_u8()?;\n368\t    let day = b.read_u8()?;\n369\t    let hour = b.read_u8()?;\n370\t    let minute = b.read_u8()?;\n371\t    let second = b.read_u8()?;\n372\t    // production status and type of data — not stored in Field currently\n373\t    Ok((\n374\t        center,\n375\t        subcenter,\n376\t        ReferenceTime { year, month, day, hour, minute, second, significance },\n377\t    ))\n378\t}\n379\t\n380\t// ── Section 3: Grid Definition ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n381\t\n382\tfn parse_section3(body: &[u8]) -> Result<(u16, GridDefinition)> {\n383\t    let mut b = Buf::new(body);\n384\t    b.skip(1)?; // source of grid definition (oct 6)\n385\t    let num_data_points =      }\n407\t        _ => Err(Error::NotImplemented),\n408\t    }\n409\t}\n410\t\n411\t/// Grid Definition Template 3.0: Latitude/Longitude.\n412\tfn parse_gdt_0(b: &mut Buf, num_data_points: u32) -> Result<GridDefinition> {\n413\t    let shape_of_earth = b.read_u8()?; // oct 15\n414\t\n415\t    // Scale/value for earth shape (spheroid parameters) — not needed for GDT 3.0 geometry.\n416\t Polar Stereographic Projection.\n457\t///\n458\t/// Byte layout (b starts at section octet 15 = first body byte after template number):\n459\t///\n460\t/// | Octets | Field |\n461\t///       dj: 0.0,\n518\t        scanning_mode,\n519\t        resolution_flags,\n520\t        shape_of_earth,\n521\t        projection,\n522\t    })\n523\t}\n524\t\n525\t/// Grid Definition Template 3.30:                            // oct 68–71 (N, not Dj)\n648\t    let scanning_mode = b.read_u8()?;     // oct 72\n649\t\n650\t    let projection = GridProjection::GaussianLatLon(GaussianLatLonParams { n_parallels });\n651\t\n652\t    Ok(GridDefinition {\n653\t        template: 40,\n654\t        num_data_points,\n655\t        nx,\n656\t        ny,\n657\t        lat_first,\n658\t        lon_first,\n659\t        lat_last,\n660\t        lon_last,\n661\t        di,\n662\t        dj: 0.0,   // not stored in GDT 3.40; N replaces Dj\n663\t        scanning_mode,\n664\t        resolution_flags,\n665\t        shape_of_earth,\n666\t        projection,\n667\t    })\n668\t}\n669\t\n670\t// ── Section 4: Product Definition ────────────────────────────────────────────\n671\t\n672\tfn parse_section4(\n673\t    body: &[u8],\n674\t    discipline: u8,\n675\t) -> Result<(u16, ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n676\t    let mut b = Buf::new(body);\n677\t    let _n_coord = b.read_u16be()?; // oct 6-7: number of coordinate values\n678\t    let template = b.read_u16be()?; // oct 8-9: PDT template number\n679\t\n680\t    match template {\n681\t        0 => {\n682\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_0(&mut b, discipline)?;\n683\t            Ok((0, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n684\t        }\n685\t        1 => {\n686\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_1(&mut b, discipline)?;\n687\t            Ok((1, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n688\t        }\n689\t        2 => {\n690\t            // Product Definition Template 4.2: Analysis or forecast at a horizontal level\n691\t            // Same as PDT 4.0 for our purposes (uses common header only)\n692\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_0(&mut b, discipline)?;\n693\t            Ok((2, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n694\t        }\n695\t        8 => {\n696\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_8(&mut b, discipline)?;\n697\t            Ok((8, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n698\t        }\n699\t        11 => {\n700\t            let (param, fore, lvl, ens) = parse_pdt_11(&mut b, discipline)?;\n701\t            Ok((11, param, fore, lvl, ens))\n702\t        }\n703\t        _ => Err(Error::NotImplemented),\n704\t    }\n705\t}\n706\t\n707\t/// Parse the common PDT header fields shared by templates 4.0, 4.1, 4.8, 4.11.\n708\t///\n709\t/// Reads octets 10–34 (parameter, time, and level fields).  The caller reads\n710\t/// any template-specific tail octets after calling this function.\n711\tfn parse_pdt_common_header(\n712\t    b: &mut Buf,\n713\t    discipline: u8,\n714\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level)> {\n715\t    let category = b.read_u8()?;  // oct 10\n716\t    let number = b.read_u8()?;    // oct 11\n717\t    b.skip(1)?; // generating process type (oct 12)\n718\t    b.skip(1)?; // background generating process id (oct 13)\n719\t    b.skip(1)?; // analysis/forecast generating process id (oct 14)\n720\t    b.skip(2)?; // hours of cutoff after reference time (oct 15-16)\n721\t    b.skip(1)?; // minutes of cutoff (oct 17)\n722\t    let time_range_unit = b.read_u8()?;    // oct 18\n723\t    let forecast_offset = b.read_u32be()?; // oct 19-22\n724\t\n725\t    let type1 = b.read_u8()?;                     // oct 23\n726\t    let scale_factor1 = b.read_i8()?;             // oct 24\n727\t    let scaled_value1 = b.read_u32be()? as i32;   // oct 25-28\n728\t\n729\t    let raw_type2 = b.read_u8()?;                     // oct 29\n730\t    let raw_scale_factor2 = b.read_i8()?;             // oct 30\n731\t    let raw_scaled_value2 = b.read_u32be()? as i32;   // oct 31-34\n732\t\n733\t    // When second surface type is 255 (missing), zero out its scale/value\n734\t    // to match eccodes behavior.\n735\t    let (type2, scale_factor2, scaled_value2) = if raw_type2 == 255 {\n736\t        (255u8, 0i8, 0i32)\n737\t    } else {\n738\t        (raw_type2, raw_scale_factor2, raw_scaled_value2)\n739\t    };\n740\t\n741\t    let param = ParameterId { discipline, category, number };\n742\t    // Reference time is filled in from Section 1 by the caller.\n743\t    let fore = ForecastTime {\n744\t        reference_time: ReferenceTime {\n745\t            year: 0, month: 0, day: 0, hour: 0, minute: 0, second: 0, significance: 0,\n746\t        },\n747\t        time_range_unit,\n748\t        forecast_offset,\n749\t    };\n750\t    let lvl = Level { type1, scale_factor1, scaled_value1, type2, scale_factor2, scaled_value2 };\n751\t\n752\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl))\n753\t}\n754\t\n755\t/// Product Definition Template 4.0: Analysis or forecast at horizontal level.\n756\tfn parse_pdt_0(\n757\t    b: &mut Buf,\n758\t    discipline: u8,\n759\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n760\t    let (param, fore, lvl) = parse_pdt_common_header(b, discipline)?;\n761\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl, None))\n762\t}\n763\t\n764\t/// Product Definition Template 4.1: Individual ensemble forecast, control and\n765\t/// perturbed, at a horizontal level at a point in time.\n766\t///\n767\t/// WMO GRIB2 Table 4.1:\n768\t/// - Octs 10–34: common header (same as PDT 4.0)\n769\t/// - Oct 35: type of ensemble forecast (Table 4.6)\n770\t/// - Oct 36: perturbation number\n771\t/// - Oct 37: number of forecasts in ensemble\n772\tfn parse_pdt_1(\n773\t    b: &mut Buf,\n774\t    discipline: u8,\n775\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n776\t    let (param, fore, lvl) = parse_pdt_common_header(b, discipline)?;\n777\t\n778\t    let member_type = b.read_u8()?;          // oct 35: Table 4.6\n779\t    let perturbation_number = b.read_u8()?;  // oct 36\n780\t    let _n_ensemble = b.read_u8()?;          // oct 37: number in ensemble (unused by harness)\n781\t\n782\t    let ens = Ensemble { member_type, number: perturbation_number as i16 };\n783\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl, Some(ens)))\n784\t}\n785\t\n786\t/// Product Definition Template 4.8: Average, accumulation, extreme values or\n787\t/// other statistically-processed values at a horizontal level in a continuous\n788\t/// or non-continuous time interval.\n789\t///\n790\t/// WMO GRIB2 Table 4.8:\n791\t/// - Octs 10–34: common header (same as PDT 4.0)\n792\t/// - Oct 35: year (u16), month, day, hour, minute, second of end of interval\n793\t/// - Oct 41: number of time range specifications (n)\n794\t/// - Octs 42 onward: n × 12-byte time range specifications (skipped)\n795\t///\n796\t/// Only the common header fields are surfaced; the statistical window\n797\t/// information is not yet modelled in `ForecastTime`.\n798\tfn parse_pdt_8(\n799\t    b: &mut Buf,\n800\t    discipline: u8,\n801\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n802\t    let (param, fore, lvl) = parse_pdt_common_header(b, discipline)?;\n803\t\n804\t    // End-of-interval timestamp and time-range specs: skip entirely.\n805\t    // Oct 35-40: end time (year u16 + month + day + hour + min + sec = 7 bytes)\n806\t    b.skip(7)?;\n807\t    // Oct 41: number of time range specs\n808\t    let n_ranges = b.read_u8()? as usize;\n809\t    // Each spec is 12 bytes.\n810\t    b.skip(12 * n_ranges)?;\n811\t\n812\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl, None))\n813\t}\n814\t\n815\t/// Product Definition Template 4.11: Individual ensemble member +\n816\t/// time-processed statistical product at a horizontal level.\n817\t///\n818\t/// WMO GRIB2 Table 4.11:\n819\t/// - Octs 10–34: common header (same as PDT 4.0)\n820\t/// - Oct 35: type of ensemble forecast (Table 4.6)\n821\t/// - Oct 36: perturbation number\n822\t/// - Oct 37: number of forecasts in ensemble\n823\t/// - Oct 38-43: end-of-interval timestamp (year u16 + month + day + hour + min + sec)\n824\t/// - Oct 44: number of time range specifications (n)\n825\t/// - Octs 45+: n × 12-byte time range specs (skipped)\n826\tfn parse_pdt_11(\n827\t    b: &mut Buf,\n828\t    discipline: u8,\n829\t) -> Result<(ParameterId, ForecastTime, Level, Option<Ensemble>)> {\n830\t    let (param, fore, lvl) = parse_pdt_common_header(b, discipline)?;\n831\t\n832\t    let member_type = b.read_u8()?;          // oct 35\n833\t    let perturbation_number = b.read_u8()?;  // oct 36\n834\t    let _n_ensemble = b.read_u8()?;          // oct 37\n835\t\n836\t    // Oct 38-43: end-of-interval timestamp (7 bytes: year u16 + month + day + hour + min + sec)\n837\t    b.skip(7)?;\n838\t    // Oct 44: number of time range specs\n839\t    let n_ranges = b.read_u8()? as usize;\n840\t    b.skip(12 * n_ranges)?;\n841\t\n842\t    let ens = Ensemble { member_type, number: perturbation_number as i16 };\n843\t    Ok((param, fore, lvl, Some(ens)))\n844\t}\n845\t\n846\t// ── Section 5: Data Representation ───────────────────────────────────────────\n847\t\n848\tfn parse_section5(body: &[u8]) -> Result<(u16, PackingInfo, Option<ComplexPackingExtra>, usize)> {\n849\t    let mut b = Buf::new(body);\n850\t    let n_values = b.read_u32be()? as usize; // oct 6-9: number of packed values\n851\t    let template = b.read_u16be()?;           // oct 10-11: DRT template number\n852\t\n853\t    match template {\n854\t        0 => {\n855\t            let packing = parse_drt_common(&mut b)?;\n856\t            Ok((0, packing, None, n_values))\n857\t        }\n858\t        2 => {\n859\t            let (packing, extra) = parse_drt_2(&mut b)?;\n860\t            Ok((2, packing, Some(extra), n_values))\n861\t        }\n862\t        3 => {\n863\t            let (packing, extra) = parse_drt_3(&mut b)?;\n864\t            Ok((3, packing, Some(extra), n_values))\n865\t        }\n866\t        40 => {\n867\t            // Template 5.40: JPEG 2000 data compression — same common header as DRT=0.\n868\t            let packing = parse_drt_common(&mut b)?;\n869\t            Ok((40, packing, None, n_values))\n870\t        }\n871\t        41 => {\n872\t            // Template 5.41: PNG data compression — same common header as DRT=0.\n873\t            let packing = parse_drt_common(&mut b)?;\n874\t            Ok((41, packing, None, n_values))\n875\t        }\n876\t        _ => Err(Error::NotImplemented),\n877\t    }\n878\t}\n879\t\n880\t/// Parse the common packing header shared by DRT templates 0, 2, and 3.\n881\tfn parse_drt_common(b: &mut Buf) -> Result<PackingInfo> {\n882\t    let reference_value = b.read_f32be()?;               // oct 12-15: R\n883\t    let binary_scale_factor = b.read_scale_factor_i16()?; // oct 16-17: E\n884\t    let decimal_scale_factor = b.read_scale_factor_i16()?; // oct 18-19: D\n885\t    let bits_per_value = b.read_u8()?;                   // oct 20: N\n886\t    let original_field_type = b.read_u8()?;              // oct 21\n887\t\n888\t    Ok(PackingInfo {\n889\t        reference_value,\n890\t        binary_scale_factor,\n891\t        decimal_scale_factor,\n892\t        bits_per_value,\n893\t        original_field_type,\n894\t    })\n895\t}\n896\t\n897\t/// Data Representation Template 5.2: Complex packing (no spatial differencing).\n898\tfn parse_drt_2(b: &mut Buf) -> Result<(PackingInfo, ComplexPackingExtra)> {\n899\t    let packing = parse_drt_common(b)?;  // oct 12-21: common header\n900\t\n901\t    b.skip(1)?; // oct 22: group splitting method\n902\t    b.skip(1)?; // oct 23: missing value management (0 = none)\n903\t    b.skip(4)?; // oct 24-27: primary missing value\n904\t    b.skip(4)?; // oct 28-31: secondary missing value\n905\t\n906\t    let n_groups = b.read_u32be()?;              // oct 32-35\n907\t    let ref_group_widths = b.read_u8()?;         // oct 36\n908\t    let bits_group_widths = b.read_u8()?;        // oct 37\n909\t    let ref_group_lengths = b.read_u32be()?;     // oct 38-41\n910\t    let length_increment = b.read_u8()?;         // oct 42\n911\t    let true_last_group_length = b.read_u32be()?; // oct 43-46\n912\t    let bits_scaled_group_lengths = b.read_u8()?; // oct 47\n913\t    // Octets 48-49 (order_spatial_diff, extra_octet_count) are absent in template 5.2.\n914\t\n915\t    Ok((packing, ComplexPackingExtra {\n916\t        n_groups,\n917\t        ref_group_widths,\n918\t        bits_group_widths,\n919\t        ref_group_lengths,\n920\t        length_increment,\n921\t        true_last_group_length,\n922\t        bits_scaled_group_lengths,\n923\t        order_spatial_diff: 0,\n924\t        extra_octet_count: 0,\n925\t    }))\n926\t}\n927\t\n928\t/// Data Representation Template 5.3: Complex packing with spatial differencing.\n929\tfn parse_drt_3(b: &mut Buf) -> Result<(PackingInfo, ComplexPackingExtra)> {\n930\t    let packing = parse_drt_common(b)?;  // oct 12-21: common header\n931\t\n932\t    b.skip(1)?; // oct 22: group splitting method\n933\t    b.skip(1)?; // oct 23: missing value management (0 = none)\n934\t    b.skip(4)?; // oct 24-27: primary missing value\n935\t    b.skip(4)?; // oct 28-31: secondary missing value\n936\t\n937\t    let n_groups = b.read_u32be()?;              // oct 32-35\n938\t    let ref_group_widths = b.read_u8()?;         // oct 36\n939\t    let bits_group_widths = b.read_u8()?;        // oct 37\n940\t    let ref_group_lengths = b.read_u32be()?;     // oct 38-41\n941\t    let length_increment = b.read_u8()?;         // oct 42\n942\t    let true_last_group_length = b.read_u32be()?; // oct 43-46\n943\t    let bits_scaled_group_lengths = b.read_u8()?; // oct 47\n944\t    let order_spatial_diff = b.read_u8()?;       // oct 48\n945\t    let extra_octet_count = b.read_u8()?;        // oct 49\n946\t\n947\t    Ok((packing, ComplexPackingExtra {\n948\t        n_groups,\n949\t        ref_group_widths,\n950\t        bits_group_widths,\n951\t        ref_group_lengths,\n952\t        length_increment,\n953\t        true_last_group_length,\n954\t        bits_scaled_group_lengths,\n955\t        order_spatial_diff,\n956\t        extra_octet_count,\n957\t    }))\n958\t}\n959\t\n960\t// ── Section 6: Bit Map ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n961\t\n962\t/// Parse Section 6 (Bit Map).\n963\t///\n964\t/// Returns `(has_bitmap, bitmap_bytes)`:\n965\t/// - `has_bitmap=false, bitmap_bytes=None` when indicator == 255 (all points present).\n966\t/// - `has_bitmap=true, bitmap_bytes=Some(bytes)` when indicator == 0: one bit per grid\n967\t///   point, MSB-first packed, length = ceil(n_grid_points / 8).\n968\tfn parse_section6(body: &[u8]) -> Result<(bool, Option<Vec<u8>>)> {\n969\t    let mut b = Buf::new(body);\n970\t    let indicator = b.read_u8()?; // oct 6\n971\t    match indicator {\n972\t        255 => Ok((false, None)),\n973\t        0 => {\n974\t            // Remaining bytes are the bitmap (1 bit per grid point, MSB first).\n975\t            let bitmap = body[1..].to_vec();\n976\t            Ok((true, Some(bitmap)))\n977\t        }\n978\t        _ => Err(Error::NotImplemented),\n979\t    }\n980\t}\n981\t\n982\t// ── Bitmap expansion ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n983\t\n984\t/// Expand a vector of packed (present-only) values into a full `n_grid`-length\n985\t/// masked grid using the bitmap.\n986\t///\n987\t/// The bitmap is a packed MSB-first bit array (one bit per grid point). Where\n988\t/// the bit is 1, the next value from `packed` is used; where 0, the grid point\n989\t/// is absent (value = 0.0, present = false). Returns `GridValues::Masked` if\n990\t/// a bitmap is provided and `n_packed < n_grid`, otherwise returns the input\n991\t/// as a `Dense` grid.\n992\tfn expand_bitmap(\n993\t    packed: GridValues,\n994\t    bitmap: &Option<Vec<u8>>,\n995\t    n_grid: usize,\n996\t) -> GridValues {\n997\t    let bm = match bitmap {\n998\t        Some(bm) => bm,\n999\t        None => return packed, // no bitmap — pass through\n1000\t    };\n1001\t\n1002\t    let packed_vals = match packed {\n1003\t        GridValues::Dense(v) => v,\n1004\t        other => return other, // already masked somehow — pass through\n1005\t    };\n1006\t\n1007\t    if packed_vals.len() == n_grid {\n1008\t        // The packed count already matches the grid — no expansion needed.\n1009\t        return GridValues::Dense(packed_vals);\n1010\t    }\n1011\t\n1012\t    let mut values = vec![0.0f64; n_grid];\n1013\t    let mut present = vec![false; n_grid];\n1014\t    let mut packed_idx = 0usize;\n1015\t\n1016\t    for grid_idx in 0..n_grid {\n1017\t        let byte = grid_idx / 8;\n1018\t        let bit = 7 - (grid_idx % 8); // MSB first\n1019\t        let is_present = byte < bm.len() && (bm[byte] >> bit) & 1 == 1;\n1020\t        if is_present {\n1021\t            if packed_idx < packed_vals.len() {\n1022\t                values[grid_idx] = packed_vals[packed_idx];\n1023\t                packed_idx += 1;\n1024\t            }\n1025\t            present[grid_idx] = true;\n1026\t        }\n1027\t    }\n1028\t\n1029\t    GridValues::Masked { values, present }\n1030\t}\n1031\t\n1032\t// ── Section 7: Data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n1033\t\n1034\tfn decode_section7(\n1035\t    body: &[u8],\n1036\t    packing: &PackingInfo,\n1037\t    drt: u16,\n1038\t    complex_extra: Option<&ComplexPackingExtra>,\n1039\t    n_points: usize,\n1040\t) -> Result<GridValues> {\n1041\t    if let Some(extra) = complex_extra {\n1042\t        return decode_drt3(body, packing, extra, n_points);\n1043\t    }\n1044\t\n1045\t    if drt == 40 {\n1046\t        #[cfg(feature = \"jpeg2000\")]\n1047\t        return decode_drt40(body, packing, n_points);\n1048\t        #[cfg(not(feature = \"jpeg2000\"))]\n1049\t        return Err(Error::NotImplemented);\n1050\t    }\n1051\t\n1052\t    if drt == 41 {\n1053\t        return decode_drt41(body, packing, n_points);\n1054\t    }\n1055\t\n1056\t    // DRT=0: simple packing.\n1057\t    let r = packing.reference_value as f64;\n1058\t    let e = packing.binary_scale_factor as i32;\n1059\t    let d = packing.decimal_scale_factor as i32;\n1060\t    let two_e = 2f64.powi(e);\n1061\t    let ten_d = 10f64.powi(d);\n1062\t\n1063\t    match packing.bits_per_value {\n1064\t        0 => {\n1065\t            // Constant field: X=0 for all points, so Y = (R + 0) / 10^D = R / 10^D.\n1066\t            let v = r / ten_d;\n1067\t            Ok(GridValues::Dense(vec![v; n_points]))\n1068\t        }\n1069\t        n_bits => {\n1070\t            let packed = unpack_n_bits(body, n_points, n_bits as usize);\n1071\t            // WMO spec: Y × 10^D = R + X × 2^E  →  Y = (R + X × 2^E) / 10^D\n1072\t            let values: Vec<f64> = packed.iter().map(|&x| (r + x as f64 * two_e) / ten_d).collect();\n1073\t            Ok(GridValues::Dense(values))\n1074\t        }\n1075\t    }\n1076\t}\n1077\t\n1078\t/// Decode Template 5.40: JPEG 2000 data compression.\n1079\t///\n1080\t/// Section 7 contains a JPEG 2000 codestream (J2K) or JP2 container. The first\n1081\t/// component carries packed integers X; decoded values follow: Y = (R + X × 2^E) / 10^D.\n1082\t#[cfg(feature = \"jpeg2000\")]\n1083\tfn decode_drt40(body: &[u8], packing: &PackingInfo, n_points: usize) -> Result<GridValues> {\n1084\t    let img = jpeg2k::Image::from_bytes(body)\n1085\t        .map_err(|_| Error::InvalidData(\"JPEG2000 decode failed\"))?;\n1086\t    let comp = img.components().first()\n1087\t        .ok_or(Error::InvalidData(\"J2K: no image components\"))?;\n1088\t\n1089\t    let r = packing.reference_value as f64;\n1090\t    let e = packing.binary_scale_factor as i32;\n1091\t    let d = packing.decimal_scale_factor as i32;\n1092\t    let two_e = 2f64.powi(e);\n1093\t    let ten_d = 10f64.powi(d);\n1094\t\n1095\t    let data = comp.data(); // &[i32] — raw packed integer X values\n1096\t    let values: Vec<f64> = data.iter()\n1097\t        .take(n_points)\n1098\t        .map(|&x| (r + x as f64 * two_e) / ten_d)\n1099\t        .collect();\n1100\t\n1101\t    if values.len() < n_points {\n1102\t        return Err(Error::InvalidData(\"J2K: fewer pixels than grid points\"));\n1103\t    }\n1104\t\n1105\t    Ok(GridValues::Dense(values))\n1106\t}\n1107\t\n1108\t/// Decode Template 5.41: PNG data compression.\n1109\t///\n1110\t/// Section 7 contains a raw PNG image. Pixel values are packed integers X;\n1111\t/// decoded grid values follow the standard formula: Y = (R + X × 2^E) / 10^D.\n1112\t/// Only 8-bit and 16-bit grayscale PNGs are supported (the common GRIB2 case).\n1113\tfn decode_drt41(body: &[u8], packing: &PackingInfo, n_points: usize) -> Result<GridValues> {\n1114\t    let cursor = std::io::Cursor::new(body);\n1115\t    let decoder = png::Decoder::new(cursor);\n1116\t    let mut reader = decoder.read_info().map_err(|_| Error::InvalidData(\"PNG header decode failed\"))?;\n1117\t\n1118\t    let buf_size = reader.output_buffer_size().ok_or(Error::InvalidData(\"PNG: buffer size unknown\"))?;\n1119\t    let mut img_data = vec![0u8;
